input.quote: B. User Manuals. The reports made available to Customer shall be in substantial conformity with the customer bulletins and the User Manuals, as amended from time to time, copies of which have been, or will be, provided to Customer.
input.rationale: Section 16.1 contains only a systems-capability representation (A), a promise that reports will substantially conform to customer bulletins and User Manuals (B), rights and authority reps, and a Millennium compliance rep, all wrapped by an all-other-warranties disclaimer in 16.1.F. A report-to-manual conformity promise is not a software-to-documentation warranty, and no provision (16.1, Section 9 Performance Standards, Section 12.3 remedies or Section 13 Damages) gives repair, replacement or refund for non-conforming software or Services; the Service Level Credits at 9.2.D are redacted. Section 9.1 does commit M&I to perform the Services in accordance with the Performance Standards for the whole term, which satisfies the fallback services-duration element. The gaps in the software conformance period and the warranty remedy are material fallback failures, so we add the shortest conforming clause as a new Section 16.1.G, which the "EXCEPT AS SPECIFICALLY SET FORTH IN THIS SECTION 16.1" disclaimer preserves without further edits.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 16.1 warrants only system capability and that reports substantially conform to the User Manuals, with no software conformance period and no warranty remedy, so we add a 90-day software-to-documentation warranty and a repair, replacement or refund remedy as a new Section 16.1.G, which the existing disclaimer expressly preserves.

ops.text: Software Conformance; Warranty Remedies. M&I warrants that the software used to provide the Services will conform in all material respects to its documentation for a period of at least ninety (90) days following the date such software is first used to provide the Services. Customer's remedies for breach of the warranties in this Section 16.1 shall include, at M&I's option, repair or replacement of the non-conforming software or Services or a refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming software or Services.
